features.quote: Hard cap: 40 turns reached (a turn = one model response, regardless of how many tool calls it contains)
Model declares completion: Model emits a final response with no tool calls and uses language indicating task is done
Explicit refusal: Model states it cannot solve the task and stops calling tools for 2 consecutive turns
This experiment is at risk of motivated interpretation — 'emotional instability' is a construct that can be projected onto text. Pre-registration mitigates this.
